summary: Completed API and browser testing for the Custodian prototype. Discovery, filtering, mystery routing, experience detail, mock booking, legacy submission, custodian profile, tourist passport, dashboard consent controls, calendar, and responsive overflow checks passed.

ui_bugs.issue: Hamburger button is visible at mobile width but has no onClick behavior and opens no menu, leaving the primary navigation hidden behind an inert control.

action_items: Implement the mobile menu toggle and render accessible Discover, My passport, and For custodians links, or remove the inert hamburger control.
critical_code_review_comments: Mobile menu button is rendered without an event handler or expanded navigation state in Shell.
Detail and profile data fetches have no visible error state; a failed request can leave the user indefinitely on the loading message.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data created; tested against the six in-memory illustrative experiences. Booking and legacy responses are MOCKED by design per the request.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All required desktop and mobile-width core flows passed. Recheck the mobile hamburger after implementation, including keyboard/accessibility behavior; API regression tests are in test_custodian_api.py.
rca of the issue: Shell always renders the mobile-menu button but does not maintain menu state or attach an onClick handler. At <=560px CSS hides .nav-links, so clicking the visible hamburger produces no navigation effect. Add state plus an expanded mobile nav (with data-testid and accessible label), or remove the button and provide another navigation affordance.
